### Borea v0.2.0-dev.3: test build for developers

This pre-release is for the Borea team and developers who want to test v0.2.0 before it is released.
It is not for playing. For normal use, stay on v0.1.0.
v0.2.0 follows in a few days.
Tell us what did not work: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [GitHub issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/issues)

#### Download this one by hand

In dev.1 and dev.2, "Update now" and `borea update-self` stop with "The new build could not take the place of this one, so Borea was not changed." Your build stays as it was.
The defect is in the build that runs the update, so neither of them can update itself.
Download dev.3 from this page once, and replace your build with it.

#### Please test the update from dev.3

From dev.3 on, Borea updates itself.
When the next build is out, use "Update now" on the Home banner, or `borea update-self`, and tell us whether Borea restarts as the new build in the same folder.

#### New since v0.2.0-dev.2

- Borea can update itself: it no longer fails after it put the new build in place.
- An update that cannot start the new build puts every file of your build back, not only the program.

#### How to get the next test builds

With the default update channel, "Stable releases", Borea does not tell you about pre-releases like this one.
To see them, open Settings, General, and set "Update channel for Borea" to "All releases, dev builds included".
"Check for updates at start" must be on, and the change takes effect at the next start.
When v0.2.0 is released, every channel tells you about it.
